dsh-skin-nebula 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。动漫皮肤包：忍者、樱花、竹林、落日、苍龙五套 AI 生成高清主题，各配专属点缀色，右上角衣服图标一键切换，透明度可调。

posts.en:
dsh-skin-nebula is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-87d78ab3da3a41ec751e.html
